title: Toss a King's Coin Down the Well
description: Toss a King's Coin Down the Well — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: The Wishing Well

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Toss a King's Coin down the well for good luck!

Quest Reward: None listed

Return to: The Wishing Well

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Toss a King's Coin down the well for good luck!

Offer:

The Wishing Well likes to eat coins!

Turn-in:

The King's Coin clanks as you toss it down the well.

Objectives:

  • King's Coin ×1

Level range: 1–100
